source_text: Si non attingit manus eius ad ovem, duos turtures. Deus onera temperat. Pauperum munera non spernit.
pass_a_gloss: If not reaches hand his to sheep, two turtledoves. God burdens tempers. Of-poor gifts not he-rejects.
pass_b_english: If his hand cannot reach a sheep, he brings [[two turtledoves >> Bible:Leviticus 5:7]]. God tempers burdens. He does not despise the poor’s gifts.
